description: Defines GUIDs for Intel HEVC video decoders, data structures for supported resolution ranges, and declares a function to get supported D3D11 video decoder resolutions within the media namespace.

classes.name: SupportedResolutionRange
classes.description: Holds minimum and maximum supported resolution sizes for landscape and portrait orientations.

methods.name: GetSupportedD3D11VideoDecoderResolutions
methods.description: Returns a map of video codec profiles to their supported resolution ranges for a given D3D11 device, considering driver workarounds.
